revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Comparing Heights
revealWordProblem.text: Two of the tallest formations on Earth are Mount Everest and Mauna Kea. The summit of Mount Everest is +8,849 meters relative to sea level. Mauna Kea is a dormant volcano on the island of Hawaii; its base sits at -6,005 meters (below sea level) on the ocean floor. How far is each point from sea level? Use absolute value to compare the distances.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A diagram comparing Mauna Kea and Mount Everest against sea level: Everest 29,035 feet, Mauna Kea 13,796 feet above and −19,700 feet below sea level.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Everest's summit is |+8,849| = 8,849 meters from sea level, and Mauna Kea's base is |-6,005| = 6,005 meters from sea level. Everest's summit is farther from sea level because 8,849 > 6,005.

questions.stem: What is the absolute value of -9?
questions.explanation: Absolute value is the distance from zero. -9 is 9 units from zero, so |-9| = 9.
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you got the sign backwards. Instead: Absolute value is the distance from zero.
0 would only be the answer if the number were zero. Count how many units sit between -9 and 0 on the number line.
The 1 doesn't come from measuring the distance. Absolute value counts the units from zero to the number, whatever the sign.
hints: Absolute value asks: how FAR is -9 from zero? It's about distance, not direction.
Picture -9 on a number line and count the hops back to 0. A distance is never negative.
Start at -9 and count the steps to reach 0: 1, 2, 3, ... How many hops does it take in all?
questions.explanationEs: El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero. -9 está a 9 unidades de cero, así que |-9| = 9.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta: ¿qué tan LEJOS está −9 de cero? Se trata de distancia, no de dirección.

Empieza en −9 y cuenta los pasos para llegar a 0: 1, 2, 3, … ¿Cuántos saltos hacen falta en total?

questions.stem: Which integer has the GREATEST absolute value: -3, 7, -5, 2?
choiceFeedback: |-5| = 5 is a big distance, but one option sits even farther from zero. Distance ignores the sign — measure every number before deciding.
|-3| = 3, one of the shortest distances in the list. Compare the distances from zero, not the signs.
|2| = 2, the smallest distance of all. Find each number's absolute value, then compare them.
hints: 'Greatest absolute value' means farthest from zero — the sign doesn't matter.
Find each number's distance from 0: |-3|, |7|, |-5|, |2|. Then pick the biggest distance.
Start with |-3| = 3 and |-5| = 5. Now find the distances for 7 and 2 and compare all four.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál entero tiene el MAYOR valor absoluto: -3, 7, -5, 2?
hintsEs: 'Mayor valor absoluto' significa el más lejano de cero; el signo no importa.
Halla la distancia de cada número a 0: |−3|, |7|, |−5|, |2|. Luego elige la distancia mayor.

questions.explanation: Zero is 0 units from itself on the number line, so |0| = 0.
choiceFeedback: Absolute value is distance from zero, not a change to the digit.
An absolute value can never be negative, because a distance is never negative.
There is an answer: zero has an absolute value too. Ask yourself how far zero is from itself.
hints: Absolute value = distance from zero. Here the number inside the bars IS zero.
Ask: how many units do you travel from 0 to reach 0 on the number line?
Place your finger on 0. Count the hops needed to get to 0 — that count is the value of |0|.
questions.explanationEs: El cero está a 0 unidades de sí mismo en la recta numérica, así que |0| = 0.
hintsEs: Valor absoluto = distancia desde cero. Aquí el número dentro de las barras ES cero.

steps: 1. Absolute value represents distance on a number line, never direction
2. Distance is always positive or zero: |-7| = 7 and |7| = 7
3. Context: Magnitude of temperature, debt, elevation regardless of sign
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Integers and Absolute Value is judging size by the digits alone instead of position on the number line — students think -8 is 'more' than -3 because 8 > 3, when really -8 sits farther left (colder, deeper, or lower) and is actually the SMALLER integer. Absolute value measures distance from zero and is always positive or zero, but that distance does not decide which integer is greater — only left-to-right order on the number line does. Before you submit, ask: am I comparing distance from zero (absolute value) or position on the number line (greater/less than)?

An absolute value is never negative, because it is a distance. Recompute |-12| by counting units from zero.
level3.stemEs: La capitana Vega compara |-12| (una cueva profunda) y |7| (una cima). ¿Cuál valor absoluto es MAYOR?
level3.explanationEs: |-12| = 12 y |7| = 7. Como 12 > 7, el valor absoluto de -12 es mayor.
hints: Absolute value turns each number into a distance from zero, and distances are never negative.
Find |-12| and |7| separately before you compare anything.
-12 sits 12 units from zero. Work out how far 7 sits from zero, then compare those two distances.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto convierte cada número en una distancia desde cero, y las distancias nunca son negativas.
Halla |-12| y |7| por separado antes de comparar cualquier cosa.
-12 está a 12 unidades de cero. Calcula a qué distancia está 7 de cero y luego compara esas dos distancias.

level3.stem: (Lesson 7.1) At 6 a.m. in Reykjavik the temperature was -12°C. At 2 p.m. it was the opposite of the 6 a.m. temperature, and at 11 p.m. it was the opposite of the 2 p.m. temperature. What were the temperatures at 2 p.m. and 11 p.m.?
level3.explanation: The opposite of -12 is 12, so 2 p.m. was 12°C. The opposite of 12 is -12, so 11 p.m. was back to -12°C.
choiceFeedback: The two times are switched. The first opposite is taken from -12, so 2 p.m. has to land on the positive side of 0.
The 2 p.m. reading is right, but the second step doubled the distance from 0 instead of crossing back over 0. The opposite of 12 keeps the distance 12.
Zero is its own opposite, so the opposite of -12 cannot be 0. An opposite stays the same distance from 0, which is 12 units here.
hints: Take the opposites one step at a time — start with the 6 a.m. reading.
An opposite keeps the same distance from 0 and changes only the side, so -12 becomes a positive number that is still 12 units from 0.
Now take the opposite of your 2 p.m. answer. What happens when you take the opposite of an opposite?
level3.stemEs: A las 6 a.m. en Reikiavik la temperatura era -12°C. A las 2 p.m. era la opuesta a la de las 6 a.m., y a las 11 p.m. era la opuesta a la de las 2 p.m. ¿Cuáles eran las temperaturas a las 2 p.m. y a las 11 p.m.?
level3.explanationEs: El opuesto de -12 es 12, así que a las 2 p.m. era 12°C. El opuesto de 12 es -12, así que a las 11 p.m. volvió a -12°C.
hintsEs: Toma los opuestos paso a paso — empieza con la lectura de las 6 a. m.
Un opuesto conserva la misma distancia del 0 y solo cambia de lado, así que -12 se convierte en un número positivo que sigue a 12 unidades del 0.
Ahora toma el opuesto de tu respuesta de las 2 p. m. ¿Qué pasa cuando tomas el opuesto de un opuesto?
